question: The translocation t (11; 14) is characteristic of mantle lymphoma. Which fusion protein originates, capable of promoting the cells towards the S phase of the cell cycle ?:
reasoning_chain: CHAIN: Translocation t(11;14) -> Mantle lymphoma -> Fusion protein production -> Promotes cells towards S phase of the cell cycle -> Cyclin D1 -> 95% CHAIN: Translocation t(11;14) -> Mantle lymphoma -> Fusion protein production -> Promotes cells towards S phase of the cell cycle -> BCL-2 -> 95%
analysis: The fusion protein originating from the translocation t(11;14) in mantle cell lymphoma that promotes cells towards the S phase of the cell cycle is Cyclin D1.
